note: v4 study bridge, Unity side (2026-10-29). Loaded only by WarehouseRobot_v4.unity. Same as bridge_unity.json (v3 study, frozen in robot_vision/configs/hri_frozen.json, unchanged) except paths.bridge_config, which names the v4 shared config: protocol_version 3 (docs/protocol_v3.md). Host, port, rates, watchdog and limits come from that file (Python reads the same file).

nav.snap_note: As bridge_unity.json: NavMesh.SamplePosition snaps the path start (robot) and the target to the NavMesh within this distance; telemetry reports the horizontal snap distances.
nav.agent_note: As bridge_unity.json: AMR agent type, radius 0.5 m = half of the 1.00 m required passage width (robot + pallet, footprint.py).

camera_360.centre_note: As bridge_unity.json (confirmed 2026-10-20: a cube placed along world +Z appears at the centre of the equirectangular image).
